## Description {#details}

<p>implements a set of functionality in the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/targetmachine">TargetMachine</a></span> class for targets that make use of the independent code generator (CodeGen) library.</p>


<p>Must not be used directly in code unless to inherit its implementation.</p>


<p>Definition at line 23 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/codegen/codegentargetmachineimpl-h">CodeGenTargetMachineImpl.h</a>.</p>
